description:
Casts a natal chart: each planet's sign and exact degree in both the tropical (Western) and sidereal (Vedic, Lahiri) zodiacs, the ascendant, the twelve Placidus cusps, the midheaven, retrograde state and the Moon's nakshatra. It covers any chart, rising sign, Moon sign or planet-in-house. Takes a birth date (1800-2200) and a place.

The chart uses the UTC offset in force at that place on that date (East Tennessee kept Central time until 1947), and an hour's error moves the ascendant about 15 degrees, usually into another sign, with the houses following. With "time" left out for an unknown birth time, the ascendant, cusps and houses are withheld, because a stand-in time such as noon gives a wrong ascendant.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1800-2200. Example: "1977-10-19". Other formats such as "19/10/1977" are refused.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "39.76838". Paired with lon.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "-86.15804". Paired with lat.

place.description: Town or city of birth with region and country. Example: "Indianapolis, Indiana, United States". A bare "Springfield" is refused with candidates.

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour, local at the birthplace. Example: "23:58". Optional; when it is absent the ascendant and houses are withheld.

tz.description: IANA zone or numeric UTC offset hours. Example: "America/Indiana/Indianapolis" or "-5". When absent, resolved for the birth date.

name: compute_birth_chart
title: Cast a natal birth chart
